description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Fetch and read the web] Downloads one public PDF and returns its text layer page by page, with page count and title metadata. Input: url, optional max_pages. Limits: 10 MB, 50 pages, 500,000 characters; password-protected PDFs are refused and scanned images are not OCRed; robots.txt obeyed for every URL and redirect. Cached 1 h.

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

name: pdf_text

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: PDF to text, page by page ($0.002/call)
